title: Julia atlas
description: An intricate cyan fractal changes its connected islands as a complex parameter moves.
useCase: Explore topology in a complex-plane image without a 3D engine.
reducedMotion: The elapsed-time clock stops. Parameter controls immediately update the static composition.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS swatch appears if unavailable or after context loss. 88 escape iterations per pixel; a bounded visual study rather than an arbitrary-precision fractal explorer.
look: Pale icy-cyan lace-like fractal of spiral eyes and filigree islands, point-symmetric and centred on a near-black navy field.
motion: The Julia set sways slowly, rotating about 3° and drifting its constant on 45–52 s sine cycles; the parameter slider shifts the constant, reshaping and reconnecting its islands.
adapt: In `FRAGMENT`, `c` sets the Julia constant from `u_control` plus a slow `u_time` drift, `rot` adds the sway, and 88 iterations with `smoothCount` and `contours` shade it. Retune the `c` ranges and the cyan `col` mix; keep the fallback.
